# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V5003 validate_target_not_refined"
description: "Untrusted.validate(u) takes its target V from the expected type Result<V, Violation>."
---

An error from the `contract` phase. `sakura explain V5003` prints this explanation offline.

`Untrusted.validate(u)` takes its target `V` from the expected type `Result<V, Violation>`.
`V` must be a refined type whose base is the type inside the `Untrusted` (design §6.4, §17.71):
a plain type has no predicate, so nothing would be validated. Annotate the binding or the
function's return type with a refined type, or use `Untrusted.check(u, clause, pred)` for an
ad-hoc predicate.

Wrong:

```sakura
import std/untrusted
import std/core.{Violation}
fn port(u: Untrusted<Int>) -> Result<Int, Violation> { Untrusted.validate(u) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
type Port = Int where it >= 1 && it <= 65535
fn port(u: Untrusted<Int>) -> Result<Port, Violation> { Untrusted.validate(u) }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V5003_validate_into_plain_type.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V5003_validate_into_plain_type.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
import std/core.{Violation}
import std/untrusted

fn plain() -> Result<Int, Violation> { Untrusted.validate(Untrusted.of(1)) }
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V5003_validate_into_plain_type.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V5003_validate_into_plain_type.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
import std/core.{Violation}
import std/untrusted

type Small = Int where it >= 0 && it <= 10

fn small() -> Result<Small, Violation> { Untrusted.validate(Untrusted.of(1)) }
```
